notes.title: Fixes and mechanics
notes.content: Game update promotional event, this update includes small fixes and some new mechanics.

notes.title: Pet
notes.content: Adding pets and mounts, egg drop to unlock a new pet.

notes.title: Chest drop
notes.content: Pack with over 50 spells added, discover the appearances of spells by opening chests scattered around the map or dropped on zombies after level 100.

notes.content:
Mobile launch event, game was released for mobile on 02/16/2023 and to celebrate a promotion.
